text:
maria: Heads up — sampleapp onboarding tests are hitting 429s from Hosted during burst tests. Repro steps below.

maria: command: `for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{\"input\":\"x\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done`

maria: logs show server returning `HTTP 429` with header `x-rw-quota-reset: 12s` and body `quota_exceeded`

ryan: are you running the local JS SDK or the sampleapp's net client?

maria: sampleapp (Go runtime) using our new client windowing code. I see ~64 concurrent requests in pprof.

anna: hmm Go SDK and JS SDK handle auth refresh differently — Go can spawn refreshers per request if token stale, causing thundering herd. Could be token refresh + concurrency causing extra burst.

maria: token is static test key. So not refresh. Also observed that client-side governor allows 64 in-flight by default.

devx_infra: FYI buildkite test for sampleapp uses env var RW_MAX_CONCURRENCY=32; default client's `MaxInFlight` is 64 for GC2 runtime.

ryan: we should lower default and add exponential jittered backoff on 429. Current backoff is fixed sleep(1s) in client.

maria: quick patch locally: set MaxInFlight=8 + backoff: `backoff.RetryNotify(...)` — rerun shows 95% fewer 429s, latency stable.

ops-deploy: servers return headers: `x-rw-rate-limit: 16`, `x-rw-rate-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-quota-reset: 8` — client should consume these to adapt.

anna: agree, SDK parity item: JS already reads rate headers and caps concurrency; Go SDK missing that adapter. Filed GH issue: #1123

ryan: can we ship a hotfix to sampleapp onboarding guide and bump default in Go SDK minor? Also add snippet in quickstart:

ryan: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient(token, redwood.WithMaxInFlight(8), redwood.WithRateHeaderAware(true))
```

maria: tested that snippet — onboarding doc change fixes majority of customer repros. I'll open PR for sampleapp and docs.

devx_infra: also add healthcheck that warns when in-flight > configured limit for > 5s — helps catch misconfigs in CI.

maria: opened PR 2345 — includes sampleapp change and a small unit test around 429/backoff. CI passing.

ryan: nice. Can someone own the Go SDK parity item? Tagging @anna

anna: I'll take #1123. Plan: implement header-aware concurrency cap + jittered backoff + add opt-in default to 16 then reduce later after metrics. ETA EOD.

maria: thanks — saves customers from onboarding friction. :tada:

sdk-bot: `go test ./sdk -run TestBackpressure -v` passed (25ms)

ops-deploy: deployed sampleapp patch to staging; no 429s in 30m soak with RW_MAX_CONCURRENCY=8 :thumbsup:

maria: moving this to done column in board. closing thread.
